title: Ingest-to-SIEM Evidence Contract and Patch SLA Playbook
content:
Summary:
This working doc defines a pragmatic contract for converting scanner outputs into standardized evidence artifacts, the minimal SIEM event shape for alerting and huntability, and the RBAC v2 guardrails for who can act on evidence and SLA exceptions. It also prescribes a lightweight remediation tracking contract so teams can meet patch SLAs with traceable audit logs.

Objectives:
- Standardize evidence payloads so any downstream consumer (SIEM, ticketing, compliance) can rely on a stable set of fields.
- Keep SIEM events minimal to control ingestion cost while preserving triage signal.
- Ensure RBAC v2 is enforced for evidence approval, SLA exceptioning, and permanent deletions.
- Track remediation progress and expose ETA metadata to the SIEM for SLA monitoring.

Inputs and Scanner Sources:
- SCA scanners (deps), container scanners (Trivy/Clair variants), OS/package scanners, runtime agents (osquery/auditbeat), manual uploads from security engagements.
- Canonical ingestion expects either SARIF or scanner-specific JSON; ingestion workers normalize into the Evidence Contract.

Evidence Contract (flat key set; arrays allowed):
- evidence_id: stable GUID per ingestion (string)
- vuln_key: CVE or internal fingerprint (string)
- source_scanner: lowercase short id (e.g., trivy, scc-sast) (string)
- scanner_version: string
- target: short identifier (image:tag or host:hostname) (string)
- component: package or binary name (string)
- component_version: string
- detected_at: ISO8601 string
- ingested_at: ISO8601 string
- normalized_severity: critical/high/medium/low/info (string)
- cvss_v3: numeric-as-string or empty (string)
- evidence_links: array of s3/http URIs (list of strings)
- raw_snippets: array of short text snippets or base64-encoded attachments (list of strings)
- suggested_fix: short recommendation (string)
- triage_status: open/acknowledged/in_progress/mitigated/wontfix (string)
- assigned_owner: principal-id or team-id (string)
- remediation_eta: ISO8601 or empty (string)
- sla_policy: policy-id (string)
- immutable_approval_id: approval-event-id once approved (string)
- retention_policy: short label (e.g., default-2y) (string)

Design notes:
- Keep the evidence JSON flat to avoid complex parsing in log pipelines. Arrays are allowed but nested objects are avoided.
- evidence_links should point to the canonical evidence JSON in evidence-bucket. The evidence JSON is the authoritative artifact.
- raw_snippets must never contain PII or customer data unless explicitly tagged and allowed by legal. If present, redact and add redaction_note to the evidence file (redaction_note is an additional flat string).

SIEM Event Shape (minimal):
- siem_id: GUID (string)
- evidence_id: evidence_id (string)
- vuln_key: vuln_key (string)
- target: target (string)
- severity: normalized_severity (string)
- category: dependency|container|host|config (string)
- scanner: source_scanner (string)
- detection_time: ISO8601 (string)
- export_time: ISO8601 (string)
- evidence_uri: single s3 path (string)
- remediation_eta: ISO8601 or empty (string)
- owner: assigned_owner (string)
- sla_applied: true|false as string (string)
- tags: comma-separated short tags (string)

Export rules and frequency:
- Export only when triage_status != wontfix.
- Export on ingest and on state changes that affect SLA (assign, set_eta, mark_mitigated).
- Deduplicate exports within 5 minutes to avoid SIEM storm when a scanner flaps. Dedup by evidence_id + normalized_severity + target.

RBAC v2 Enforcement Points:
- Roles: vuln-reader, vuln-triager, vuln-approver, infra-operator, compliance-auditor. Roles are represented as short strings in actor_role_snapshot.
- Only vuln-approver or compliance-auditor can set immutable_approval_id and change triage_status to mitigated without an associated ticket closure.
- Service principals (svc.vuln.ingest.<env>) can create evidence but cannot change triage_status.
- Deletion requests of evidence (retention exceptions) require compliance-auditor approval and must set request_id and approval_id in the audit export.

Audit Log Minimal Fields (flat, required for compliance export):
- audit_id: GUID (string)
- event_type: ingest|assign|set_eta|approve|mitigate|delete_request|delete_final|sla_exception (string)
- actor_id: principal-id (string)
- actor_role_snapshot: comma-separated roles (string)
- target_evidence_id: evidence_id (string)
- target_vuln_key: vuln_key (string)
- action_time: ISO8601 (string)
- request_id: correlation id (string)
- outcome: success|failure (string)
- details_uri: s3 or internal url to a fuller audit entry (string)

Patch SLA Defaults and Behavior:
- Default SLA mapping (policy ids referenced in evidence.sla_policy):
  - policy-critical-v1: remediation_eta must be provided within 24 hours; mitigated within 7 days or recorded exception.
  - policy-high-v1: remediation_eta within 72 hours; mitigated within 30 days.
  - policy-medium-v1: remediation_eta within 14 days; mitigated within 90 days.
  - policy-low-v1: tracked; remediation ETA optional.
- If no remediation_eta is supplied on ingest for critical/high, system auto-applies remediation_eta = detected_at + policy window and sets sla_applied=true. An audit event is emitted.
- Exception flow: team requests SLA extension via ticket; approver role must provide justification. Exception writes audit event with approver and reason.

Ticketing Integration Contract:
- On new vuln_key or when evidence does not link to an open ticket, create a triage ticket with the following flat fields in the ticket body: vuln_key, evidence_id, severity, target, suggested_fix, remediation_eta, owner. Ticket creation must include the ingestion request_id in a visible field for correlation.
- Ticket transitions must emit audit events with the ticket id as details_uri.

Dependency Review Notes (special handling for SCA findings):
- For SCA (deps) findings the pipeline should attach a dependency-manifest snippet (package name + range) in raw_snippets and add a normalized_repo_path field in evidence (string) pointing to the repo path where the dependency was found.
- If the dependency is third-party with known migration guidance, suggested_fix should include a link to internal migration docs.

Operational Playbook (short):
1) Scanner emits result -> ingestion worker normalizes and writes evidence JSON to evidence-bucket -> emits SIEM event and audit_id ingest event.
2) Triage alert posted to channel; triage engineer claims and assigns owner. Assignment emits audit event.
3) Owner sets remediation_eta and begins work; setting ETA emits audit event and SIEM update.
4) If approver approves fix, approver sets immutable_approval_id and triage_status=mitigated; audit entry recorded and SIEM closing event emitted.

Retention and Access:
- Default evidence retention: 2 years; retention_policy overridable per legal request.
- Access to evidence URIs governed by RBAC v2 and short-lived presigned URLs. All presigned URL generation emits an audit event with actor and requested_ttl.

Implementation Notes / Pitfalls:
- Many scanners mutate schema between versions; ingestion must snapshot scanner_version and keep a small adapter layer.
- Avoid large binary blobs in SIEM events; store in evidence-bucket and reference via evidence_uri.
- Ensure idempotent ingest by computing fingerprint = sha256(scanner_fingerprint + target + component + detected_at) and dedup on that value.

Open actions:
- Decide canonical service principal naming (proposal: svc.vuln.ingest.<env>).
- Finalize policy ids and map to internal SLA dashboard (JIRA-4620).
- Add example SARIF->Evidence mappings and a test vector for Trivy and SCA tools.

Contacts and owners:
- Document owner: Diego Alvarez (security infra)
- RBAC implementer: Ananya Rao
- SIEM lead: Michael Chen

Notes (working draft):
- This is intentionally conservative on fields to make early adoption low-risk. We can add optional enrichment fields later (exploitability_score, exploit_kit_refs, vendor_fix_url) but keep them optional strings.
- Pilot plan: roll out ingestion + SIEM export for two services (platform-api and webapp) for 4 weeks and gather metrics on SLA auto-applies and audit volume.
